    if not counts:
        return out
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    color_points = {v: [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x == v] for v in counts}
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    r0,r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1 = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
    mr = color_points[marker]
    mr0,mr1=min(r for r,c in mr),max(r for r,c in mr)
    mc0,mc1=min(c for r,c in mr),max(c for r,c in mr)
    # Output frame expansion distances follow the marker block's margins,
    # with the singleton marker case expanding one cell in both axes.
    top_margin = max(1, mr0-r0, r1-mr1)
    side_margin = max(1, mc0-c0, c1-mc1)
    if len(mr) == 1:

    # Use the observed border thickness on each dimension; singleton markers

    side_margin = max(1, mc0-c0, c1-mc1)
    if len(mr) == 1:

    top, bottom = max(0,r0-top_margin), min(h-1,r1+top_margin)
    left, right = max(0,c0-side_margin), min(w-1,c1+side_margin)
    for r in range(top,bottom+1):
